position_motor_diagnostic.availability: missing component is unavailable, not zero; null completed mean denotes unqualified full-step coverage; null effective ceiling is unbounded, while zero is an observed zero cap and not positive-finite-bound eligible
position_motor_diagnostic.bound_scope: final solved positive-finite motor impulse bound occupancy over observed solver slices; distinct from requested target or target-rate clamps
position_motor_diagnostic.physics_world_id_scope: local namespace within one backend instance; not a global or cross-backend identity
position_motor_diagnostic.scope: evaluator-only Rapier ForceBased one-DoF multibody position-motor solver readback; signed applied motor impulse excludes hard limits, contacts, and direct effort sensors; no hardware validation or fall-cause claim
position_motor_diagnostic.timing: post-step readback: command consumer t bound to completed interval [t,t+dt]; numerical solver duration and integer nominal ticks are both retained

last_delivered_feedback.actual_support_points_scope: driver pre-step ground truth; not feedback input

zero_age_literal_words.format: 16-byte RNE_G1_WORDS_V1 NUL header, little-endian u64 row count; each row has plant/control/old-decision vectors, each prefixed by u64 word count followed by literal u64 words
zero_age_literal_words.scope: full trajectory including settlement; immutable policy is bound separately and does not pollute mutable control words or old decision fields

window_analysis_context.scope: Descriptive evaluator-only native position-motor interval readback. Peak completed means exclude partial coverage and do not measure within-slice peaks. FINAL motor-bound occupancy uses actual positive-finite eligible solver duration; zero/infinite caps and missing samples are separately counted. Failed cases retained. No threshold fitting, fall cause, hardware saturation, or cross-platform determinism claim.

original_window_result_context.physics_world_id_scope: Backend-instance-local recording identity; not stable identity across runs.

cases.original_window_result_scope: Original analysis-time raw stream paths/digests are preserved; use current_stream_storage_binding for actual retained storage, not raw-file presence.

streams.storage_verification: Current raw bytes SHA-256/length match original repeated measurement metadata.

diagnostic_jsonl.control_tick_scope: one pre-step decision per 1 ms tick, including settlement; no reduced controller frequency
diagnostic_jsonl.phase_origin: absolute simulation ticks; recording_relative_ticks starts after 2 s settlement

feedback_policy_configuration.filtered_channel: controller-facing world angular velocity X only at positive capture age
feedback_policy_configuration.filtered_rate_time_scope: EMA over delivered captures, not a current gyro measurement

feedback_policy_configuration.missing_sample: no history update; retain nominal-stance startup behavior
feedback_policy_configuration.new_capture_update: first raw X exactly; then alpha = 1 - exp(-capture_spacing_s / tau_s)
feedback_policy_configuration.orientation_projection: unchanged orientation_known_age using original captured world gyro
feedback_policy_configuration.orientation_time_scope: consumer-time model estimate using constant captured world angular rate
feedback_policy_configuration.zero_age: borrow original payload with no arithmetic or history update

noise.distribution: independent bounded signed-uniform synthetic estimate errors
noise.load_saturation: zero lower bound, saturation counts recorded
